description: T-4130: does Excel for the web open and apply each caption (label) filter type of a pivot? Data!A1:C9 has Region, Product and Sales: East Apple 10, East Apricot 4, East Banana 5, East Cherry 3, West Apple 20, West Banana 7, West Grape 6, West Cherry 8 (Product sums Apple 30, Apricot 4, Banana 12, Cherry 11, Grape 6). Each sheet is one builder-v2 pivot at A3, rows Product, Sum of Sales, with one `<filter fld="1">` of the type the sheet names, written as Excel writes it (stringValue1/2 and the autoFilter's customFilters, wildcards for begins/ends/contains): CEq captionEqual Cherry; CNe captionNotEqual Cherry; CBw captionBeginsWith Ap; CNb captionNotBeginsWith Ap; CEw captionEndsWith e; CNew captionNotEndsWith e; CCo captionContains an; CNc captionNotContains an; CGt captionGreaterThan Banana; CGe captionGreaterThanOrEqual Banana; CLt captionLessThan Banana; CLe captionLessThanOrEqual Banana; CBt captionBetween B and D; CNbt captionNotBetween B and D; CMix captionEqual whose stringValue1 says Cherry and whose customFilter says Grape; CBwU captionBeginsWith AP, CCoU captionContains AN, CEqL captionEqual banana and CGtU captionGreaterThan BANANA (patterns in another case than the items); CBtI captionBetween Banana and Cherry (bounds that are items). (A filter of type `unknown` makes the web refuse the file: pivots.md.) Pivot cells are in the sidecar's `pivots` section; Q!A1 makes the case scored.
